title: R1300GS Trophy Edition (Circuit Spec)
description: The BMW Motorrad R1300GS Trophy Edition (Circuit Spec) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Adventure Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1300cc engine generating 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 228 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
